mapper.select: SELECT ms.*, u.nickname AS user_name, sk.code AS skill_code, sk.name AS skill_name FROM mdm_member_skill ms LEFT JOIN system_users u ON u.id = ms.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN mdm_skill sk ON sk.id = ms.skill_id AND sk.deleted = 0 WHERE ms.deleted = 0 AND ms.user_id = #{userId} AND ms.skill_id = #{skillId} ORDER BY ms.user_id ASC, ms.id ASC
